metric_convention: Standalone microbenchmark runtime/nvidia/experiments/fa_pv_bench.cu: d_flash_prefill<HD,BQ,BKV> launched at grid=188 / 256 threads (the interpreter's launch geometry), nsplit=1 fused path, seq_q=8192 (max prefill bucket), seq_kv swept, q_pos0=seq_kv-seq_q (last-chunk tail). cudaEvent timing, warmup 2, averaged. The SAME source compiled against the FFMA-serial P.V header vs the T4 register-resident mma.sync P.V header — the delta is the P.V lever alone. BOTH headers carry the sliding tile-skip FIX (below), so the A/B is correct-vs-correct.
baseline_commit: 18ea793 (T2 GEMM-prefill tiling; FLASH_PREFILL = mma QK^T (T1) + FFMA-serial P.V)
change: T4: register-resident mma.sync m16n8k16 P.V with an HD-SPLIT warp partition. A = softmax probs P (staged bf16 into Ps, ldmatrix.x4); B = V (staged natural in Vs[kv][hd], ldmatrix.x2.trans — the exact operand layout QK's K^T load validates, no extra V transpose). O is the register-resident mma f32 accumulator; online-softmax rescale (corr = exp(m_old-m_new)) multiplies the accumulator fragment directly. HD split so each warp owns 16(query) x 128(hd) = 64 f32 acc/lane (WPV_M=BQ/16 query-warp-rows x WPV_N hd-warp-cols = all 8 warps). The QK / softmax / P.V phases own DIFFERENT warp grids, so the online (m,l,corr) state is smem-resident. Retires the FFMA lane-parallel o[RPW][DE] loop.

campaigns.note: correct-vs-correct A/B (both FFMA and mma headers carry the sliding tile-skip fix).
campaigns.reading: The register-resident mma P.V removes the FFMA-serial O(ctx^2) tail: the hd512 full-attention arm (the 128k prefill driver) is 2.3-3.1x faster, and the hd256 sliding arm 3.8x. The win is largest where the FFMA P.V dominated (short/mid ctx, less HBM-bound), and holds 2.3x at the 128k tail where the kernel becomes KV-read bound.

sliding_tile_skip_fix: SEPARATE pre-existing bug found + fixed in the same file: d_flash_prefill's per-tile sliding skip `if (window && (qabs_max-(kv0+BKV-1)) >= window) continue;` used qabs_max (the NEWEST query in the q-tile), dropping tiles the OLDER queries still attend at the window's trailing edge (~BQ positions). It corrupted EVERY sliding layer (40 of 48 in 12B) — hidden because the flash-prefill oracle REFERENCE was degenerate (masked entries left at -INFINITY poisoned Oref with inf, collapsing report() to a spurious relL2=0/maxabs=inf that PASSED any kernel, even the wave64 negctrl; T1/T2's reported 'relL2 0' was this artifact). Verified pre-existing: the baseline FFMA kernel fails the identical sliding cases with identical relL2 (0.4995/0.6459/0.3745) against the FIXED ref. Fix: drop the per-tile skip (eff_lo=oldest-query floor + the causal break are the correct bounds; per-row masking handles partial tiles) AND fix the oracle ref (masked->0). After both fixes: all flash-prefill oracle cases PASS at bf16-P precision (causal + sliding + soft-softmax, relL2 1.5-2.4e-3); the now-SENSITIVE wave64 negctrl flips every flash case to FAIL. Prefill _pf megakernel 234 regs (was 236), 0 spill, occ-1.
